findings.text: 有模型和受控实验资源、能核方法的研究者管理长期实验；六阶段全链是作者说明，本轮不全验论文/评审，见[Q01](#research-q01)。
UI/API/user项目→队列/DB Voyage→registry Helm行动→远端指标→模型反思改文件→signal追加下一轮，再规则/LLM验证；真实闭环见[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)。

工程统计按表列MD/TS/TSX/JS及变体，未计核心Python；含vendor/测试/示例候选，非原创/工时，不手补PY数。固定摘要/身份已核，无正式identity旧稿。只读桌面/本地引擎、实验创建/queue/registry/DB loop、Sextant代表、SSH/容器选择与指标/预算/远端Key写路径；未执行目标/脚本/测试/模型或外部动作，未全审所有provider、领域runner、安全/退出、文献/写文/评审。
桌面polaris-desktop与Python后端均0.1.0声明，root私有工作区0.0.0；组件/远端发行各自核，不据root占位当应用发布版本。固定提交日期非发布日期。
本地引擎/模型与资料，SSH/GPU/容器按所选Runner/任务而异，不当全产品必需；完整四列表见[Q04](#research-q04)。
首启Python/模型/测试资源，持续修复/数据/算力，失败核已有作业再续，退出分别处理本地与远端/可选Key文件；现金/人工四阶段见[Q04](#research-q04)。
可丢弃合成已知答案任务，借已核API显式confirm_budget与正max_hours，固定允许模型/Runner资源；当前创建Modal未提交确认字段，不把默认GUI当有预算人工门，见[Q03](#research-q03)。
可执行/续作、结果存在、授权/资源三个效果层有源码支持；独立实验真值、总费/净节时未知，效果表见[Q03](#research-q03)。
保留真Observation→反思→改文件→再run和持久尝试/PID重挂；条件Gate、主指标出现/报告终检与独立科学验证分层，不把模板命令当生成代码沙箱。
将真实计划/代码执行/指标反思组织成持久步骤、尝试/恢复与条件人介入；主能力按独立操作展开，已有终检/来源机制边界见[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)。
confirm_budget默认false且当前创建Modal不传，0小时不限时；生成脚本指标入DB不等独立测量，自检/规则/模型判定不等研究结果正确，eval_model可真实下发Key到远端，见[Q03](#research-q03)、[Q04](#research-q04)。
超出现有重挂/指标终检与文献manifest，验证Python-ML候选代码和固定独立评测器/数据划分的结果来源边界；反例/成本/停止条件见[Q05](#research-q05)。

technical.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)熟知Agent/状态机/SSH科研组合novelty25%超纯包装0%，非新研究算法阻50%；[Q02](#research-q02)/[Q03](#research-q03)持久反馈/重挂/验证分层mechanism75%超单pipeline50%，全部异常/独立真值与成本边界未闭合阻100%；registry/Runner分离transfer50%超硬编码单脚本25%，大工程/后端依赖与运行适配未核阻75%；统一活动/记录simplification50%超手串25%，维护/方法与总投入未证阻75%。

business.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)/[Q03](#research-q03)实验从发起到反思workflow50%超单模型代码25%，真实研究交付/独立评测未证阻75%；桌面/本地服务/Runner分层delivery/reach50%超一次性脚本25%，成品/团队需求和全后端兼容未证阻75%；已有时间/轮次/无提升与重挂护栏economics25%超无资源机制0%，默认不限时/不审批且非现金cap，无净费收益阻50%。

recommendation.reason: 已有模型服务、可丢弃测试资源并能通过已核API显式设预算确认与正时间限的研究者，可用 Polaris 在合成已知答案任务中组织实验代码、运行记录和反思迭代。相比手串脚本与日志，源码支持持久步骤和真实结果反馈后改文件再运行，但默认创建界面没有预算人工门，脚本指标入库与自验证也不能替代独立评测和研究方法验收。若费用或权限超出允许范围、指标无法复算或远端作业状态不明，应暂停后续迭代，核真实进程、数据与可选模型Key文件，保留工件后退回原有实验脚本和人工评测流程。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)长时受控实验50%超泛科研Agent25%，真实频率/六阶段成果对照阻75%。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)真反馈/持久记录与[Q03](#research-q03)续作50%超仅提示25%，独立结果/既有追踪平台替代阻75%。

evidence.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)到[Q04](#research-q04)caller/callee/SSH/指标/反证源码50%超README25%，未运行模型/资源/独立结果阻75%。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04)合成测试与显式配置可限范围25%超只能直接真GPU/数据0%，本地引擎/模型/远端权限、预算默认和Key/退出恢复负担阻50%。

data.reports:
# Polaris > 独立桌面/Python研究工作台，以持久Voyage驱动真实实验执行与模型反思迭代；预算审批是条件开关，运行指标和自验证不等独立科研真值。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[ZJU-REAL/Polaris](https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/Polaris) - **版本号**：0.1.0（桌面与Python后端声明；根私有工作区0.0.0）（[固定提交 09005681bdbd03d7771c690e5f5431c864a8e707](https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/Polaris/tree/09005681bdbd03d7771c690e5f5431c864a8e707)） - **版本日期**：2026-10-10（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 固定源闭合桌面/Python引擎接线、真实创建/队列/持久状态机与实验反思改文件再run，核SSH/指标/条件预算关键callee。未运行目标/模型/GPU/在线demo，不全审六阶段/所有runner与平台；限已知答案小实验、显式预算/允许资源试用。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：有模型和受控实验资源、能核方法的研究者管理长期实验；六阶段全链是作者说明，本轮不全验论文/评审，见[Q01](#research-q01)。 - **亮点**：将真实计划/代码执行/指标反思组织成持久步骤、尝试/恢复与条件人介入；主能力按独立操作展开，已有终检/来源机制边界见[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)。 - **思考**：confirm_budget默认false且当前创建Modal不传，0小时不限时；生成脚本指标入DB不等独立测量，自检/规则/模型判定不等研究结果正确，eval_model可真实下发Key到远端，见[Q03](#research-q03)、[Q04](#research-q04)。 - **建议**：超出现有重挂/指标终检与文献manifest，验证Python-ML候选代码和固定独立评测器/数据划分的结果来源边界；反例/成本/停止条件见[Q05](#research-q05)。 采用建议：可丢弃合成已知答案任务，借已核API显式confirm_budget与正max_hours，固定允许模型/Runner资源；当前创建Modal未提交确认字段，不把默认GUI当有预算人工门，见[Q03](#research-q03)。 ## 核心贡献 将真实计划/代码执行/指标反思组织成持久步骤、尝试/恢复与条件人介入；主能力按独立操作展开，已有终检/来源机制边界见[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)。 ## 关键质疑 confirm_budget默认false且当前创建Modal不传，0小时不限时；生成脚本指标入DB不等独立测量，自检/规则/模型判定不等研究结果正确，eval_model可真实下发Key到远端，见[Q03](#research-q03)、[Q04](#research-q04)。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 超出现有重挂/指标终检与文献manifest，验证Python-ML候选代码和固定独立评测器/数据划分的结果来源边界；反例/成本/停止条件见[Q05](#research-q05)。 受控任务独立真值比当前脚本/Polaris/固定评测器，注入常量/旧run/错split/失败有数字/重挂；同时看误通过、费用/重复作业、工时与维护，见[Q05](#research-q05)。 ## 场景与替代办法 有模型和受控实验资源、能核方法的研究者管理长期实验；六阶段全链是作者说明，本轮不全验论文/评审，见[Q01](#research-q01)。 研究者现有脚本/作业平台+模型+实验追踪日志；不把模型/SSH/数据库或三个角色命名当原创科学算法。 ## 依赖与流程 本地引擎/模型与资料，SSH/GPU/容器按所选Runner/任务而异，不当全产品必需；完整四列表见[Q04](#research-q04)。 UI发起→持久计划/步骤→写/跑/取指标→反思/改文件→再执行/停问→人核结果；完整步骤表见[Q01](#research-q01)，实际反馈见[Q02](#research-q02)。 ## 成本与效果 首启Python/模型/测试资源，持续修复/数据/算力，失败核已有作业再续，退出分别处理本地与远端/可选Key文件；现金/人工四阶段见[Q04](#research-q04)。 可执行/续作、结果存在、授权/资源三个效果层有源码支持；独立实验真值、总费/净节时未知，效果表见[Q03](#research-q03)。 ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：固定源限定实验Voyage代表链，判断真实Agent反馈、采用成本与独立评测方向。 ### Q01 · Polaris真实应用与本轮核心范围是什么？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、功能与机制、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 Polaris是Electron桌面、Python本地研究引擎、Web UI及插件/集成组成的研究工作台，根对象归client，不是根DSH插件，也不是只看TypeScript kernel就能代表的科研Agent。desktop和backend各声明0.1.0，root私有工作区0.0.0，不当已发布应用/远端统一版本。README六阶段“文献到审稿论文”为作者产品说明，本轮只选实验Voyage的直接活动链、重要失败和采用边界；不把未展开的全套论文/引用/协作等功能计成本轮已验成果。 正常桌面main先createWindow再后台startKernel，窗口通过app协议加载页面。kernel bootstrapEngine准备Python环境；backend argv启动app.main FastAPI，legacy-engine插件真实spawn。桌面main包指dist/main.cjs且esbuild实际对应src/main/index.ts，源码构建接线不等发行物已验证。Python依赖/数据库/队列与模型/远端Runner形成采用条件，非只有一份Skill。面向有模型/实验资源且能核研究方法的研究者，可把手串实验代码、日志、指标和反思组织成长期任务；真实需求/节时和科研结论质量未独立验证。 | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 判据/失败 | |---|---|---| | 应用 | Electron加载前端并启动本地Python引擎 | 引导/健康不是科研任务完成 | | 发起 | UI带参数创建experiment，API按user/project校验并入队Voyage | 参数/凭据/资源不可用明确拒绝 | | 计划 | Navigator选实验步骤，动作LLM生成计划/文件 | 外骨架部分固定模板，不因三角色名当三个独立模型 | | 执行/迭代 | Runner写文件/运行/取指标，模型反思改文件再run | 真实受限action闭环，预算/审批条件见Q03 | | 交接 | DB/checkpoint/日志/报告供人检查 | 至少主指标/报告等终检不等科学发现已证 | #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[package.json:1-12](https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/Polaris/blob/09005681bdbd03d7771c690e5f5431c864a8e707/package.json#L1-L12) 根私有工作区0.0.0。

      "content": "<p align=\"center\">\n  <img src=\"docs/assets/polaris-logo.svg\" alt=\"Polaris\" width=\"440\">\n</p>\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <strong>Autonomous, end-to-end AI research: from literature to a reviewed paper.</strong><br>\n  Powered by a long-running agent core that plans, executes, and self-verifies its own work, turning every task into a resumable, auditable, human-gated run.\n</p>\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <img src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/AI_Scientist-7438F0?style=flat-square&logo=data:image/svg%2bxml;base64,PHN2ZyB4bWxucz0iaHR0cDovL3d3dy53My5vcmcvMjAwMC9zdmciIHZpZXdCb3g9IjAgMCAyNCAyNCIgZmlsbD0id2hpdGUiPjxwYXRoIGQ9Ik0xMiAxQzEzLjIgNyAxNSA4LjggMjIgMTIgMTUgMTUuMiAxMy4yIDE3IDEyIDIzIDEwLjggMTcgOSAxNS4yIDIgMTIgOSA4LjggMTAuOCA3IDEyIDFaIi8+PC9zdmc+&logoColor=white\" alt=\"AI Scientist\">\n  <a href=\"http://101.37.174.109:8080\"><img src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/Live_Demo-online-2ea44f?style=flat-square&logo=rocket&logoColor=white\" alt=\"Live Demo\"></a>\n  <a href=\"https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/Polaris/releases/latest\"><img src=\"https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/ZJU-REAL/Polaris?style=flat-square&color=7438F0&label=release\" alt=\"Latest release\"></a>\n  <a href=\"LICENSE\"><img src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache_2.0-blue?style=flat-square\" alt=\"License: Apache 2.0\"></a>\n  <a href=\"docs/assets/wechat-group-qr.jpg\"><img src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/WeChat-join_group-07C160?style=flat-square&logo=wechat&logoColor=white\" alt=\"Join the WeChat group\"></a>\n</p>\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <strong>English</strong> · <a href=\"README.zh-CN.md\">简体中文</a>\n</p>\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <img src=\"docs/assets/polaris-banner.jpg\" alt=\"Polaris: from literature to a reviewed paper\" width=\"100%\">\n</p>\n\n---\n\nPolaris runs the entire research lifecycle in one desktop app: literature survey, idea generation,\nidea review, experiment building on real GPU servers, LaTeX paper writing, and paper review. It is\nbuilt for one researcher on their own computer — everything runs locally, with no server to set up —\nand it treats every long task as a **Voyage**: a persisted, resumable, human-gated agent run that can\nspan hours or days without losing state.\n\n> [!NOTE]\n> Polaris is not a chatbot wrapper. The heavy lifting (crawling, parsing, deduplication, metric parsing,\n> citation matching) is deterministic code. LLMs are reserved for the judgement calls: scoring,\n> synthesis, drafting, and review. This split keeps runs cheap, reproducible, and auditable.\n\n## Demo\n\nA 2-minute tour of the platform: the six-stage pipeline, the Voyage agent core, a real experiment\nrun, and PolarisBuddy.\n\nhttps://github.com/user-attachments/assets/388972c1-7ffa-45f2-94c4-07f388379ba2\n\n### Try it live\n\nA guest account on an older, frozen web instance, for looking around (new releases are desktop-only):\nsign in at\n<http://101.37.174.109:8080> with the username `guest` and the password `zjuguest123`.\n\n**The account is for demonstration only: it is read-only and cannot call any model.** It reaches every\nscreen, the admin views included, but nothing it does changes state — creating, editing, deleting and\nuploading are all refused, and no LLM call will run, whether from chat, compilation or the assistant.\nIt is there to show what the platform looks like, not to do work on it.\n\n## The research pipeline\n\nPolaris models research as six stages. Each stage produces durable artifacts that the next stage\nconsumes, and every hand-off can pause at a human approval gate.\n\n```mermaid\nflowchart LR\n    L[\"Literature<br/>Research Wiki\"]\n    I[\"Idea<br/>Idea Forge\"]\n    R[\"Idea Review<br/>Elo debate\"]\n    X[\"Experiment<br/>GPU / SSH\"]\n    W[\"Paper Writing<br/>LaTeX\"]\n    V[\"Paper Review<br/>Citation check\"]\n    S([\"Submission\"])\n\n    L --> I --> R\n    R -->|promotion gate| X\n    X --> W --> V\n    V -->|submission gate| S\n\n    classDef stage fill:#eaf1ff,stroke:#2f6bff,stroke-width:1px,color:#10233f;\n    classDef gate fill:#fff3e0,stroke:#f59e0b,stroke-width:1px,color:#5b3b00;\n    class L,I,R,X,W,V stage;\n    class S gate;\n```\n\n| Stage | What Polaris actually does |\n| --- | --- |\n| **Literature** | The Research Wiki ingests papers from OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, and arXiv. Cold start snowballs citations from anchor papers and scores relevance against the **direction library's** inclusion config — statement, goals, scope and exclusions, written through a structured AI interview — then extracts full text (PyMuPDF) and compiles a cross-linked wiki page (TL;DR, method, reusable ideas, concept backlinks). There is **one wiki per paper, shared platform-wide**: the compile prompt carries no library statement or rubric, so the same paper never reads differently depending on where you opened it, and a concept is promoted only once two papers cite it. New arXiv work arrives through the daily feed, the single entry point libraries sync from; incremental sync with watermark resume, research digests, and Obsidian vault sync. |\n| **Idea** | Idea Forge runs multi-signal gap analysis over the knowledge base (concept co-occurrence holes, extracted paper limitations, trend velocity, survey gaps) to drive retrieval-planned idea generation. Ideas are scored on four axes (novelty, feasibility, operability, impact), deduplicated semantically, and funneled to a candidate pool. A deep Research Proposal builder then hardens the winner with a plan-execute-verify loop. |\n| **Idea Review** | Configurable-persona reviewer agents debate pairwise; a judge produces an Elo tournament ranking. Lab members join the discussion live over WebSocket, and their comments enter the agent context as first-class input. |\n| **Experiment** | The Experiment Lab uses per-user, Fernet-encrypted SSH credentials to reach the lab's GPU servers. An experiment Voyage asks intake questions first, plans the study, passes a compute-budget check, writes code, runs a smoke test, launches runs with streamed logs and live metric curves, then auto-iterates: parse metrics, reflect, then improve, debug, or stop — repairing failures under a **time** budget rather than a fixed retry count. It keeps a file-based memory it reads and writes across steps, and when it is genuinely stuck it **asks the user** instead of failing. A console gives each run a task map and a terminal you can talk to mid-stream. Figures are generated and VLM-checked. |\n| **Paper Writing** | The Paper Writer opens a multi-file LaTeX project (NeurIPS, ICLR, ACL templates) with a CodeMirror 6 editor, real-time collaborative editing (CRDT), and local tectonic compilation to a live PDF preview. An agent drafts section by section, but experiment numbers may only come from real `ExperimentRun` metrics and citations must map to real knowledge-base entries. One click refreshes the references and wires the bibliography into the main TeX file. |\n| **Paper Review** | Line-by-line citation verification (existence: exact, minor, or fabricated; support: supported, partial, or unsupported) plus deterministic fact-checking of every number against the experiment record, then multi-perspective top-venue reviewer agents and a meta-review. A fabricated citation forces a non-pass. |\n\n## The Voyage agent core\n\nResearch tasks are long-running by nature: a cold-start literature backfill takes hours, an experiment\nruns for days. Polaris's central abstraction is that every complex task is a Voyage: a resumable,\nauditable run driven by a persisted three-part loop.\n\n| Component | Role |\n| --- | --- |\n| **Navigator** | Planning. Decomposes a goal into a step plan with sub-goals, dependencies, and budget. In loop mode it edits the plan incrementally as evidence arrives, rather than replanning from scratch. |\n| **Helm** | Execution. Runs a single step (LLM calls, tool calls, SSH remote ops, literature-API queries) and returns an observation. |\n| **Sextant** | Self-verification. Checks each step against structured acceptance criteria (exit code, artifact exists, schema valid, metric threshold, count, LLM rubric). Deterministic checks run first; failures feed diagnostics back to Navigator, and repeated failure escalates to a human gate. |\n\n> [!IMPORTANT]\n> A Voyage is backed by a persistent state machine (`planning -> executing -> verifying -> ...`). If the\n> app quits or crashes mid-run, the Voyage resumes from its last checkpoint after a health check. Budgets are\n> attached to the run and auto-pause it when exceeded; every plan, action, and verdict is retained and\n> replayable in the UI.\n\nNot every task needs the full cognitive loop. A shared **Runtime** shell (state machine, checkpointing,\ngates, budget, cancellation, event streaming) serves all task kinds, while the **Brain** (the full\nplan-execute-verify loop) activates only for open-ended kinds such as experiments. Predictable pipelines\n(wiki compile, idea review, paper drafting) run on fixed templates instead of being over-orchestrated.\n\n## Key features\n\n- **Research Wiki, \"compile, don't retrieve.\"** LLMs read papers and compile a persistent, cross-linked\n  knowledge base up front, instead of doing on-demand RAG at query time. One wiki per paper, shared\n  platform-wide. Research digests, and Obsidian vault sync with `[[wikilinks]]` and frontmatter.\n- **One content pool, four collections.** Every paper is stored exactly once; direction libraries,\n  topic shelves, personal libraries, and the daily feed are membership layers over that pool. Libraries\n  are decoupled from topics (many-to-many), own their own inclusion config, and come with governance:\n  curators, monthly budgets, duplicate merge, user-created libraries under admin approval, and a\n  recycle bin that stays out of search.\n- **Daily arXiv feed.** A feed of each day's new papers, with likes and one-click collection\n  into any of your libraries. It is also the single arXiv entry point: libraries sync from the\n  pool instead of querying arXiv themselves, on an admin-configurable schedule.\n- **Idea Forge.** Signal-driven gap analysis, four-axis scoring, semantic dedup, and a deep\n  Research-Proposal builder with novelty double-checking against the library and external sources.\n- **Multi-agent and human review.** Persona reviewer agents debate to an Elo ranking; humans join live\n  and are injected into the agent context, not bolted on afterward.\n- **Experiment Lab over SSH.** Agents write and run code on real GPU servers, iterate on metrics, and\n  collect logs and figures, under gated remote writes, command allow/deny lists, full audit, and triple\n  budget caps (total, per-run, concurrency). A run keeps a file-based memory across steps, repairs\n  itself under a time budget, and pauses to **ask you a question** rather than dying; its console shows\n  a task map and a terminal you can talk to while it runs.\n- **Paper Writer.** Online multi-file LaTeX with collaborative CRDT editing and local tectonic\n  compilation; agent drafting bound to real metrics and real citations, plus one-click reference\n  refresh wired into the main TeX file.\n- **Paper Review with citation verification.** Existence and support are checked per citation against the\n  library, Semantic Scholar, and OpenAlex; numbers are fact-checked against the experiment record.\n- **PolarisBuddy, an in-app assistant.** A global companion that rides along on every page: a Claude\n  Code-style multi-turn tool loop (streamed over SSE, with tool cards and inline figures) over the same\n  read-only tool layer, in `chat`, `plan` (research-only, propose before acting), and `goal` (loop toward\n  an objective) modes. It runs the same Navigator / Helm / Sextant split as a Voyage, so its steps are\n  verified rather than merely produced, and it can hand work to subagents. Its greeting is stitched from\n  real SQL counts rather than the model, it searches every library you can see, and it carries page\n  context and persistent per-user memory. It is off unless the account may call a model.\n- **Skills, in two layers.** Agent behavior is packaged as data, not code. *Voyage skills* are\n  versionable, composable `guidance`, `rubric`, `persona`, and `workflow` packs injected at named points\n  into agent prompts, enabled globally, with a publish-approve-install-rate marketplace; each Voyage\n  snapshots the skills it used for reproducibility. *Agent skills* take the SKILL.md shape with\n  three-level progressive disclosure — a one-line description in the catalog, the body fetched by\n  `skill_load` as a tool result, attachments read on demand — so the model decides what to load and the\n  prompt prefix stays cacheable.\n- **MCP tool layer.** A single registry of read-only tools (literature, knowledge, project state,\n  manuscripts, external search) is exposed both internally to the agent loop and externally as an\n  **MCP server** (Streamable HTTP and stdio) for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor, with a self-check and\n  try-it playground. Project-isolated and strictly read-only.\n- **Real-time everywhere.** SSE for agent streaming and Voyage progress; WebSocket for review\n  discussions, approval notifications, experiment log tracking, and collaborative editing.\n- **Cost accounting.** Per-call token/cost accounting attributed to project and voyage, so you can see\n  what each task spent.\n- **Agent backends and model routing.** The easiest way to give Polaris a model is an agent you already\n  use — Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and other [ACP](docs/agents.md) agents answer model calls with no\n  API key. Model APIs (OpenAI-compatible, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic) are optional. All model calls go\n  through one layer; a DB-backed routing table maps each research stage to an agent or a model and a\n  reasoning-effort level (cheap models for scoring, strong models for debate and drafting). The built-in\n  fake provider is strictly opt-in and never turned on by the product.\n\n## Tech stack\n\n| Layer | Technology |\n| --- | --- |\n| Desktop | Electron shell (macOS / Windows / Linux) that loads the web bundle over an `app://` protocol and starts the local engine |\n| Frontend | React 18 + TypeScript 5 + Vite 5, TanStack Query for all server state, CodeMirror 6, Yjs (CRDT), react-pdf, KaTeX |\n| Engine | One local process: FastAPI (fully async) + SQLAlchemy 2 + Alembic, with an in-process task queue and scheduler |\n| Data | SQLite, plus a data folder for PDFs, exports and experiment logs — all inside the app's user-data directory |\n| Remote execution | asyncssh to GPU servers; SSH keys encrypted at rest with Fernet |\n| LaTeX | tectonic, or TeX Live through latexmk — whichever is installed on your computer |\n| Models | Agent backends over ACP (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, …) or model APIs (OpenAI-compatible, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic), with a DB model-routing table |\n\n## Install\n\nPolaris is a desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux. **Download the installer from\n[Releases](https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/Polaris/releases/latest)** — `.dmg` / `.zip` (macOS, universal),\n`.exe` / portable `.zip` (Windows), `.AppImage` / `.deb` (Linux), built by CI on every `v*` tag. The\napp checks for updates and applies them without a restart where it can.\n\nThe builds are **neither signed nor notarized**, so each platform needs to be told once that the app is\nsafe to run: on macOS `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Polaris.app` (or right-click →\nOpen); on Windows choose More info → Run anyway past SmartScreen; on Linux the AppImage needs\n`libnss3 libgtk-3-0 libasound2`, and `--no-sandbox` under Ubuntu 24.04+ AppArmor.\n\nThe app runs everything on your computer: it ships its own Python engine and sets it up on first\nlaunch (SQLite, no Docker, no login, no server address). The first launch downloads a Python\ntoolchain and dependencies, which can take a few minutes; later launches start immediately.\n\nThen give Polaris a model in **Settings → Models & agents**. The easiest way is an agent you already\nuse: install and sign in to Claude Code, Codex, or Gemini CLI on the same computer, add it under\n**Agent backends**, and it answers every model call with no API key — see\n[Agent backends](docs/agents.md). Model APIs are optional; add one if you also want embeddings and\nreranking.\n\n> [!NOTE]\n> **v0.3.x and earlier** are remote-only shells that ask for a server address on first run. They\n> cannot update themselves into the local build — download a current installer from\n> [Releases](https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/Polaris/releases/latest) and install it over the old one.\n\n## _summarize_model_config(config_text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"从模型 config.json 提取**中性事实**（不下兼容性判断）：model_type / architectures /\n    有哪些配置分节（`*_config`）。是否合用（多模态、架构不被框架支持等）交给失败时的诊断 LLM——\n in cfg if k.endswith(\"_config\") and isinstance(cfg.get(k), dict))\n    if sections:\n        facts[\"config_sections\"] = sections\n    return facts\n\n\ndef _host_path_for(ref: str, plan: dict[str,       "content": "/* ============================================================\n   首启引导：用安装包里自带的 uv，在 userData 下装出一套自足的 Python\n   环境并给 legacy-engine 插件构造 command 模式配置（#607，ComfyUI 模式）。\n\n   安装包只带两样东西（electron-builder extraResources）：\n   - resources/uv/uv        钉版本的 uv 单文件二进制（fetch-uv.mjs 下载）\n   - resources/backend/     后端源码 + 构建期算好的内容哈希 .hash（stage-backend.mjs）\n\n   首次启动（或 uv/后端内容变化后）执行三步：\n     uv python install 3.12  →  uv venv  →  uv pip install <resources/backend>\n   全部产物落在 <dataDir>/engine/ 下（托管 Python、venv、uv 缓存、SQLite 库），\n   卸载应用后删 userData 即彻底清干净，绝不污染系统 Python / 系统 uv。\n\n   哨兵文件 engine/bootstrap.json 记录 {uv 版本, 后端哈希, Python 版本}：\n   三者都没变就整段跳过（后续启动零开销）。哈希是构建期写死在包里的，\n   运行时只读——不在每次启动时对上千个文件现算。\n\n   本文件刻意 electron-free：所有路径由调用方传入。这让 CI 的装包冒烟\n   （bootstrap-smoke.ts）能用 node 直接驱动同一段引导逻辑对着解包产物\n   验证，而不必在无头环境里拉起整个 Electron。\n   ============================================================ */\n\nimport { spawn } from 'node:child_process';\nimport { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';\nimport { mkdir, rm } from 'node:fs/promises';\nimport { join } from 'node:path';\n\n/** 引导要装的 Python 版本。与 backend pyproject 的 requires-python 对齐。 */\nconst PYTHON_VERSION = '3.12';\n\n/** 本地引擎监听端口。与 legacy-engine 插件的默认端口保持一致。 */\nexport const ENGINE_PORT = 18080;\n\nexport type BootstrapPhase = 'check' | 'python' | 'venv' | 'install' | 'ready';\n\nexport interface BootstrapProgress {\n  phase: BootstrapPhase;\n  /** 子进程的一行输出（uv 的下载/安装进度都在 stderr 里）。 */\n  line?: string;\n}\n\nexport interface BootstrapOptions {\n  /** 安装包资源目录（Electron 下是 process.resourcesPath）。 */\n  resourcesDir: string;\n  /** 可写数据根目录（Electron 下是 app.getPath('userData')）。 */\n  dataDir: string;\n  onProgress?: (p: BootstrapProgress) => void;\n}\n\n/** 引导产出：直接喂给 legacy-engine 插件的 command 模式配置。 */\nexport interface EngineCommand {\n  mode: 'command';\n  command: string[];\n  port: number;\n}\n\ninterface Sentinel {\n  uvVersion: string;\n  backendHash: string;\n  pythonVersion: string;\n}\n\nfunction readTrimmed(path: string): string {\n  return readFileSync(path, 'utf8').trim();\n}\n\n/** 跑一个 uv 子进程；输出逐行转发进度回调，非零退出带日志尾巴抛错。 */\nfunction run(\n  argv: string[],\n  env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv,\n  phase: BootstrapPhase,\n  onProgress?: (p: BootstrapProgress) => void,\n): Promise<void> {\n  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n    const child = spawn(argv[0]!, argv.slice(1), { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'], env });\n    const tail: string[] = [];\n    const emit = (line: string): void => {\n      if (!line.trim()) return;\n      tail.push(line);\n      if (tail.length > 50) tail.shift();\n      onProgress?.({ phase, line });\n    };\n    // 每个流各留一段「半行」：data 块可能切在行中间，拼上下一块再按行发\n    const capture = () => {\n      let partial = '';\n      const onData = (chunk: Buffer): void => {\n        const parts = (partial + chunk.toString()).split('\\n');\n        partial = parts.pop() ?? '';\n        for (const line of parts) emit(line);\n      };\n      const flush = (): void => {\n        emit(partial);\n        partial = '';\n      };\n      return { onData, flush };\n    };\n    const out = capture();\n    const err = capture();\n    child.stdout!.on('data', out.onData);\n    child.stderr!.on('data', err.onData);\n    child.on('error', reject);\n    // close 而非 exit：exit 时 stdio 可能还有没读完的尾巴，close 保证流已读尽\n    child.on('close', (code, signal) => {\n      out.flush();\n      err.flush();\n      if (code === 0) resolve();\n      else {\n        reject(\n          new Error(\n            `engine-bootstrap: ${argv.join(' ')} 失败 (code=${code}, signal=${signal})\\n${tail.join('\\n')}`,\n          ),\n        );\n      }\n    });\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * 引导（或复用）内嵌后端环境，返回 legacy-engine 的 command 配置。\n * 幂等：哨兵匹配时不产生任何子进程，只做几次文件读取。\n */\nexport async function bootstrapEngine(opts: BootstrapOptions): Promise<EngineCommand> {\n  const { resourcesDir, dataDir, onProgress } = opts;\n\n  const uvBin = join(resourcesDir, 'uv', process.platform === 'win32' ? 'uv.exe' : 'uv');\n  const backendDir = join(resourcesDir, 'backend');\n  for (const [what, path] of [\n    ['uv 二进制', uvBin],\n    ['后端源码', join(backendDir, 'pyproject.toml')],\n    ['后端哈希', join(backendDir, '.hash')],\n  ] as const) {\n    if (!existsSync(path)) {\n      throw new Error(`engine-bootstrap: 安装包里缺少${what}（${path}）——打包时没跑 stage:resources？`);\n    }\n  }\n  const uvVersion = readTrimmed(join(resourcesDir, 'uv', 'version.txt'));\n  const backendHash = readTrimmed(join(backendDir, '.hash'));\n\n  const engineDir = join(dataDir, 'engine');\n  const venvDir = join(engineDir, 'venv');\n  const venvPython =\n    process.platform === 'win32'\n      ? join(venvDir, 'Scripts', 'python.exe')\n      : join(venvDir, 'bin', 'python');\n  const sentinelPath = join(engineDir, 'bootstrap.json');\n\n  onProgress?.({ phase: 'check' });\n  const wanted: Sentinel = { uvVersion, backendHash, pythonVersion: PYTHON_VERSION };\n  let fresh = true;\n  try {\n    const current = JSON.parse(readFileSync(sentinelPath, 'utf8')) as Partial<Sentinel>;\n    fresh = !(\n      current.uvVersion === wanted.uvVersion &&\n      current.backendHash === wanted.backendHash &&\n      current.pythonVersion === wanted.pythonVersion &&\n      existsSync(venvPython)\n    );\n  } catch {\n    /* 哨兵不存在或损坏 → 全量引导 */\n  }\n\n  if (fresh) {\n    await mkdir(engineDir, { recursive: true });\n    // uv 的一切可变状态都圈进 engine/：托管 Python、缓存都不落用户主目录，\n    // UV_NO_CONFIG 再挡掉用户自己的 uv.toml（比如镜像源/固定 python 目录），\n    // only-managed 保证绝不用系统里碰巧存在的 Python——机器上有没有 Python\n    // 结果必须一致。\n    const env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = {\n      ...process.env,\n      UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR: join(engineDir, 'python'),\n      UV_CACHE_DIR: join(engineDir, 'uv-cache'),\n      UV_PYTHON_PREFERENCE: 'only-managed',\n      UV_NO_CONFIG: '1',\n      // Windows 上 Python 默认 cp1252，读 UTF-8 源码/配置直接 charmap 崩；\n      // 统一强制 UTF-8 模式，其余平台本就是 UTF-8，无副作用\n      PYTHONUTF8: '1',\n    };\n    delete env.VIRTUAL_ENV; // 开发者 shell 里的 venv 不能泄漏进来\n\n    onProgress?.({ phase: 'python' });\n    await run([uvBin, 'python', 'install', PYTHON_VERSION], env, 'python', onProgress);\n\n    onProgress?.({ phase: 'venv' });\n    // 重建而不复用：哨兵不匹配意味着依赖集合可能变了，增量升级一个旧 venv\n    // 会攒出「卸载不净」的幽灵依赖，全量重来才可复现\n    await rm(venvDir, { recursive: true, force: true });\n    await run([uvBin, 'venv', '--python', PYTHON_VERSION, venvDir], env, 'venv', onProgress);\n\n    onProgress?.({ phase: 'install' });\n    await run([uvBin, 'pip', 'install', '--python', venvPython, backendDir], env, 'install', onProgress);\n\n    writeFileSync(sentinelPath, `${JSON.stringify(wanted, null, 2)}\\n`);\n  }\n\n  onProgress?.({ phase: 'ready' });\n  return { mode: 'command', command: buildEngineCommand(venvPython, backendDir, engineDir), port: ENGINE_PORT };\n}\n\n/**\n * 引擎启动 argv：与 legacy-engine docker 模式的 `sh -lc \"alembic && uvicorn\"`\n * 同构，但 command 模式没有 shell，所以用 python -c 的小启动器串联两步。\n * 启动器同时负责 cwd、数据库地址与用户数据目录：\n * - chdir 到后端源码目录——alembic.ini 的 script_location/prepend_sys_path\n *   都是相对 cwd 的相对路径；\n * - POLARIS_DATABASE_URL 指到 userData 的 SQLite 文件（数据库路径是引导方\n *   才知道的信息，所以写在启动器里）；\n * - POLARIS_DATA_DIR 指到 userData 的 engine/data/（#718）：后端 data_dir\n *   默认相对 './data'，chdir 之后会落进 App 安装包的 resources/backend/，\n *   应用更新整包替换时用户的 PDF/导出/实验日志就全没了。setdefault 而非\n *   覆写：给高级用户留 env 改道的口子。\n */\nfunction buildEngineCommand(venvPython: string, backendDir: string, engineDir: string): string[] {\n  const dbPath = join(engineDir, 'polaris.db').split('\\\\').join('/');\n  const snapshotRoot = join(engineDir, 'snapshots').split('\\\\').join('/');\n  const dataDir = join(engineDir, 'data').split('\\\\').join('/');\n  const bootstrapPackagedEngine();\n  }\n  if (engine) {\n    // 引擎安全（#850）：每份安装的密钥文件与孤儿引擎记录都放在 userData。\n    // 只传路径——密钥本身由 legacy-engine 插件读出后经环境变量交给引擎，\n    // 不进条目配置（plugins.list 会把配置原样交给渲染进程）。\n    const userData = app.getPath('userData');\n    engine = {\n      ...engine,\n      secretsFile: join(userData, 'engine-secrets.json'),\n      pidFile: join(userData, 'engine.pid.json'),\n    };\n  }\n  if (engine && configTree) {\n    // 引擎注入走 entry.update 而不是 tree.update：后者会把 enabled+spec\n    // 写进持久树，下次启动 env 变了树还按旧答案自启引擎；entry.update 只\n    // 改内存态并同步拉起 fiber，磁盘上始终是 disabled 占位——树保存用户\n    // 意图（要不要这个插件），引擎参数每次启动现算注入。\n    // entry.update 内部 init → fiber.await()：resolve 返回时引擎已健康或\n    // 已抛错。#721 起窗口先于内核创建：首个文档的 CSP 可能没放行本地引擎，\n    // 前端首启等待页在 bootstrapStatus done 后 reload 拿到最终 CSP 与地址。\n    let entry = configTree.store['legacy-engine'];\n    if (!entry) {\n      // 条目不见了（用户删掉、导入了不含它的树）：没有引擎整个应用就只剩兜底页，\n      // 而用户没有任何界面能把它加回来——补一个 disabled 占位，与首启种子同形。\n      console.warn('[kernel] 配置树没有 legacy-engine 条目，重新补上占位');\n      try {\n        await configTree.create({\n          id: 'legacy-engine',\n          name: 'cordis:legacy-engine',\n          disabled: true,\n        } as Parameters<SqliteTree['create']>[0]);\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error('[kernel] 补 legacy-engine 条目失败：', err);\n      }\n      entry = configTree.store['legacy-engine'];\n    }\n    if (entry) {\n      try {\n        await entry.update({ config: engine, disabled: null });\n      } catch (err) {\n        // 失败时 Entry.update 自己把 options 回滚到 disabled 且不落库，\n        // 用户树不被污染；这里只记录错误，前端会显示「引擎没启动」页。\n        engineProblem = enginePortProblem(err);\n        console.error('[kernel] 本地引擎启动失败：', err);\n      }\n    }\n  } else if (engine) {\n    console.error('[kernel] 配置树不可用，本地引擎无法注入');\n  }\n\n  await instance.start();\n  kernel = instance;\n  // 引导进度收尾：走了内嵌路径的（engine 阶段）以引擎服务是否真挂出为准；\n  // 没走内嵌路径的（starting 一路没变过：开发态 / 显式 env / 无引擎）标成\n  // idle——env 引擎的健康等待已在上方 entry.update 完成，前端拿 done 后\n  // 探测 localBackend 即得最终答案。failed（引导抛错）保持原样不覆盖。\n  if (bootstrapStatus.phase === 'engine') {\n    setBootstrapStatus(localBackend().baseUrl ? 'ready' : 'failed', true);\n  } else if (bootstrapStatus.phase === 'starting') {\n    setBootstrapStatus('idle', true);\n  }\n  return instance;\n}\n\n/**\n * 停机：dispose 根 fiber，级联回收（含本地引擎子进程）。幂等，未启动时是\n * no-op。落盘顺序由 disposer 的逆序执行保证：SqliteTree 比 storage 后装，\n * 先被 dispose——其 stop() 里 root.stop() 之后有最后一次 flush——storage\n * 关库排在其后，不需要在这里显式 flush。\n */\nexport async function stopKernel(): Promise<void> {\n  // 启动进行中（窗口先起后用户立刻退出）：等启动收尾再停，否则 kernel\n  // 还没赋值、stop 变 no-op，引导中拉起的引擎子进程/容器就漏掉了。\n  if (startingKernel) await startingKernel.catch(() => undefined);\n  const instance = kernel;\n  kernel = null;\n  if (instance) await instance.stop();\n}\n\n/**\n * kernel.status 的实现。plugins 用 ctx.registry.size —— cordis 公开文档口径\n * 「已注册插件 runtime 的数量」（vendor/deepseek-cordis/cordis/src/registry.ts），\n * 不数 fiber：同一插件多次装载仍算一个 runtime。树驱动后名额包括直挂的\n * storage、Loader（连带其内部 isolate）、SqliteTree，以及树条目拉起的\n * desktop-probe / sources（legacy-engine 视注入结果而定）。\n */\nexport function kernelStatus(): KernelStatus {\n  return {\n    started: kernel?.started ?? false,\n    name: kernel?.name ?? '',\n    plugins: kernel ? kernel.ctx.registry.size : 0,\n    // reflect 读服务：storage 插件 fiber 处于 ACTIVE 时才非空，\n    // 「装了但没起来」与「没装」在这里同样折叠成 false。\n    storage: (kernel?.ctx.get('storage') as StorageService | undefined) != null,\n  };\n}\n\n/** kernel.engineBootstrapStatus 的实现：内嵌引擎引导进度（诊断/进度条用）。 */\nexport function engineBootstrapStatus(): EngineBootstrapStatus {\n  return bootstrapTracker ? { ...bootstrapStatus, ...bootstrapTracker.snapshot() } : bootstrapStatus;\n}\n\n/**\n * plugins.* IPC 与 plugins.manage 能力位共用的树句柄。reflect 严格模式\n * 保证：kernel 没起、SqliteTree 没装、或其 fiber 不在 ACTIVE，这里一律\n * 拿到 null——能力位与方法族的「可用」判断因此天然是同一个事实。\n */\nexport function kernelConfigTree(): SqliteTree | null {\n  return (kernel?.ctx.get('configTree') as SqliteTree | undefined) ?? null;\n}\n\n/**\n * importTree 存 last-good 快照的落点。storage 挂载失败（内存树会话）时为\n * null，导入照常进行只是少一层持久保险——树本身这次会话也不落盘。\n */\nexport function kernelPluginMeta(): PluginMetaStore | null {\n  return (kernel?.ctx.get('storage') as StorageService | undefined)?.pluginMeta ?? null;\n}\n\n/**\n * kernel.localBackend 的实现。ctx.get 是 cordis 公开的免 inject 读服务入口\n * （reflect mixin，见 vendor/deepseek-cordis/cordis/src/reflect.ts），严格模式\n * 只在提供方 fiber 处于 ACTIVE 时返回值——引擎没装、还没健康、或已失败时\n * 一律拿到 undefined，统一折叠成 null。\n */\nexport function localBackend(): LocalBackendInfo {\n  const legacy = kernel?.ctx.get('legacy') as { baseUrl?: string; sessionSecret?: string } | undefined;\n  return {\n    baseUrl: legacy?.baseUrl ?? null,\n    // 本次启动的本地会话口令（#850）：只经这条 IPC 交给自己的界面\n    sessionSecret: legacy?.sessionSecret ?? null,\n    problem: legacy?.baseUrl ? null : engineProblem,\n  };\n}\n"

      "content": "import { BrowserWindow, screen, shell } from 'electron';\nimport { join } from 'node:path';\n\nimport { APP_INDEX, APP_ORIGIN } from './protocol';\nimport { clearStagedRenderer, stagedRendererDir } from './updates/renderer-store';\nimport { readConfig, writeConfig, type WindowState } from './store';\n\nlet current: BrowserWindow | null = null;\n\nexport function getWindow(): BrowserWindow | null {\n  return current;\n}\n\nfunction isSafeExternal(raw: string): boolean {\n  try {\n    const u = new URL(raw);\n    // 协议白名单：只放 http/https。放开 file:/smb: 等于给外链一个本地资源读取面。\n    return u.protocol === 'http:' || u.protocol === 'https:';\n  } catch {\n    return false;\n  }\n}\n\n/** 恢复上次的窗口位置；保存的坐标已不在任何显示器上时回落居中。 */\nfunction restoredBounds(state: WindowState) {\n  const base = { width: state.width, height: state.height };\n  if (state.x === undefined || state.y === undefined) return base;\n  const visible = screen.getAllDisplays().some((d) => {\n    const a = d.workArea;\n    return (\n      state.x! < a.x + a.width &&\n      state.x! + state.width > a.x &&\n      state.y! < a.y + a.height &&\n      state.y! + state.height > a.y\n    );\n  });\n  return visible ? { ...base, x: state.x, y: state.y } : base;\n}\n\nfunction persistBounds(win: BrowserWindow): void {\n  if (win.isDestroyed()) return;\n  const maximized = win.isMaximized();\n  // 最大化状态下取 normal bounds，否则「取消最大化」会还原成全屏尺寸\n  const b = maximized ? win.getNormalBounds() : win.getBounds();\n  writeConfig({ window: { x: b.x, y: b.y, width: b.width, height: b.height, maximized } });\n}\n\nconst isMac = process.platform === 'darwin';\nconst isWin = process.platform === 'win32';\n\n/**\n * 非 macOS 去掉了菜单栏（见 menu.ts），随之丢掉的是菜单绑定的快捷键。\n * 剪贴板类（Ctrl+C/V/X/A/Z）由 Chromium 在渲染层直接处理，不受影响；\n * 这里补回挂在菜单上的那些。\n */\nfunction installKeyboardShortcuts(win: BrowserWindow): void {\n  if (isMac) return;\n  win.webContents.on('before-input-event', (event, input) => {\n    if (input.type !== 'keyDown') return;\n    const ctrl = input.control || input.meta;\n    const key = input.key.toLowerCase();\n    const fire = (fn: () => void) => {\n      fn();\n      event.preventDefault();\n    };\n    if (key === 'f5' || (ctrl && key === 'r')) return fire(() => win.webContents.reload());\n    if (key === 'f12' || (ctrl && input.shift && key === 'i')) {\n      return fire(() => win.webContents.toggleDevTools());\n    }\n    if (!ctrl) return;\n    const zoom = win.webContents.getZoomLevel();\n    if (key === '=' || key === '+') return fire(() => win.webContents.setZoomLevel(zoom + 0.5));\n    if (key === '-') return fire(() => win.webContents.setZoomLevel(zoom - 0.5));\n    if (key === '0') return fire(() => win.webContents.setZoomLevel(0));\n  });\n}\n\nexport function createWindow(): BrowserWindow {\n  const config = readConfig();\n  const win = new BrowserWindow({\n    ...restoredBounds(config.window),\n    minWidth: 960,\n    minHeight: 600,\n    show: false,\n    backgroundColor: '#ffffff',\n    // 沉浸式标题栏：macOS 与 Windows 都不要系统标题栏，窗口控件以覆盖层形式\n    // 画在内容之上。Linux 的窗口管理器差异太大（有的根本不画覆盖层），保持原生\n    // 标题栏，稳妥。\n    titleBarStyle: isMac ? 'hiddenInset' : isWin ? 'hidden' : 'default',\n    // 把交通灯钉在这条 40px 留白带的垂直中心（(40-12)/2 = 14），不同 macOS 版本\n    // 的默认内缩量不一样，钉死才能和 global.css 的 --titlebar-h 对得上。\n    ...(isMac ? { trafficLightPosition: { x: 18, y: 14 } } : {}),\n    // Windows 的最小化/最大化/关闭画在右上角，与顶栏同一行（顶栏右端由 CSS 的\n    // --winctl-w 留出等宽空位）。配色取自 tokens.css，否则按钮区会是一块白底。\n    ...(isWin\n      ? {\n          titleBarOverlay: {\n            color: '#f7f9fc',\n            symbolColor: '#59637a',\n            // 与顶栏等高，按钮才会和铃铛排在同一行：顶栏是 52px CSS，\n            // 经 html{zoom:1.1} 渲染成约 57 个窗口点。\n            height: 57,\n          },\n        }\n      : {}),\n    webPreferences: {\n      preload: join(__dirname, 'preload.cjs'),\n      contextIsolation: true,\n      nodeIntegration: false,\n      nodeIntegrationInWorker: false,\n      sandbox: true,\n      webSecurity: true,\n      allowRunningInsecureContent: false,\n      webviewTag: false,\n      spellcheck: false,\n      // ★ 必开：写作页的论文预览是 <iframe src=blob:…pdf>，走 Chromium 内置\n      // pdfium（不是 pdf.js）。Electron 默认关插件，漏了这一项预览会全白。\n      plugins: true,\n    },\n  });\n  current = win;\n\n  if (config.window.maximized) win.maximize();\n  win.once('ready-to-show', () => win.show());\n\n  // 外链一律不在 Electron 里开：全站 20+ 处 target=\"_blank\"（arXiv、GitHub issue、\n  // 论文源站），在应用内打开会得到一个没有地址栏、退不回去的窗口。\n  win.webContents.setWindowOpenHandler(({ url }) => {\n    if (isSafeExternal(url)) void shell.openExternal(url);\n    return { action: 'deny' };\n  });\n\n  win.webContents.on('will-navigate', (event, url) => {\n    if (url.startsWith(APP_ORIGIN)) return; // SPA 内部导航\n    event.preventDefault();\n    if (isSafeExternal(url)) void shell.openExternal(url);\n  });\n\n  // 当前不需要摄像头/麦克风/定位等任何权限，默认全拒。\n  win.webContents.session.setPermissionRequestHandler((_wc, _permission, callback) => {\n    callback(false);\n  });\n\n  installKeyboardShortcuts(win);\n\n  // 热更新装上的界面若加载不起来，退回包内自带的那份再重来一次。\n  // 只挡主框架的失败；子资源 404 由协议处理器各自处理，不该整窗回滚。\n  win.webContents.on('did-fail-load', (_e, code, desc, url, isMainFrame) => {\n    if (!isMainFrame || !stagedRendererDir()) return;\n    console.error(`[polaris] 界面加载失败（${code} ${desc} ${url}），回滚到内置版本`);\n    clearStagedRenderer();\n    void win.loadURL(APP_INDEX);\n  });\n\n  win.on('close', () => persistBounds(win));\n  win.on('closed', () => {\n    if (current === win) current = null;\n  });\n\n  void win.loadURL(APP_INDEX);\n  return win;\n}\n"
    },

      "content": "import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';\nimport { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';\nimport { Icon } from '../../components/ui/Icon';\nimport { Modal } from '../../components/ui/Modal';\nimport { FormField } from '../../components/ui/FormField';\nimport { toast } from '../../components/ui/Toast';\nimport { SelectMenu } from '../../components/ui/SelectMenu';\nimport { api, type ExperimentIntakeQuestion, type RunnerBackendSummary } from '../../lib/api';\nimport { tr } from '../../lib/i18n';\nimport { topicPath } from '../../app/project';\nimport { ConfigRow } from '../voyages/shared/ConfigRow';\n\n/* ============================================================\n   新建实验 Modal：选 promoted idea + SSH 凭据 + 预算 →\n   AI 按 idea 生成 ≤5 个开题问题（代替静态 GPU 提示/高级选项表单），\n   用户作答（可跳过）→ POST /projects/{pid}/experiments。\n   其余不确定点实验过程中经提问机制动态交互——用户决定权更大、更灵活。\n   ============================================================ */\n\nexport interface NewExperimentModalProps {\n  open: boolean;\n  onClose: () => void;\n  pid: string;\n  /** 深链 /experiment?new=<idea_id> 预选的 idea。 */\n  initialIdeaId?: string | null;\n}\n\n/**\n * 这个后端要不要 SSH 凭据。\n *\n * 容器类后端（ngspice/openfoam/fmu）的 credential_kinds 是空的——后端 #716 已按\n * manifest 放宽，前端这道硬门是把它们挡在外面的最后一道。\n *\n * **清单还没加载出来时按「需要」处理**：那是今天的行为。反过来默认「不需要」的话，\n * 列表慢一拍就会放行一个没选凭据的 python-ml 实验，提交之后才发现跑不起来——而那\n * 时想法、开题问答都已经填完了。\n */\nexport function backendNeedsSsh(\n  backends: RunnerBackendSummary[],\n  selected: string,\n): boolean {\n  const chosen =\n    backends.find((b) => b.backend === selected) ?? backends.find((b) => b.is_default);\n  return chosen ? chosen.credential_kinds.includes('ssh') : true;\n}\n\nexport function NewExperimentModal({ open, onClose, pid, initialIdeaId }: NewExperimentModalProps) {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const queryClient = useQueryClient();\n\n  const [ideaId, setIdeaId] = useState('');\n  const [credentialId, setCredentialId] = useState('');\n  const [maxHours, setMaxHours] = useState('');\n  const [maxRuns, setMaxRuns] = useState('10');\n  // 空串 = 用缺省后端/不选流程包，params 里就不带这两个键——存量行为逐字节不变\n  const [backend, setBackend] = useState('');\n  const [processPack, setProcessPack] = useState('');\n  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<ExperimentIntakeQuestion[]>([]);\n  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<string[]>([]);\n  const [intakeState, setIntakeState] = useState<'idle' | 'loading' | 'ready' | 'skipped'>('idle');\n\n  const ideasQuery = useQuery({\n    queryKey: ['ideas', pid, 'promoted'],\n    queryFn: () => api.listIdeas(pid, { status: 'promoted' }),\n    enabled: open && !!pid,\n    retry: false,\n  });\n  const credsQuery = useQuery({\n    queryKey: ['ssh-credentials'],\n    queryFn: () => api.listSshCredentials(),\n    enabled: open,\n    retry: false,\n  });\n  // 后端与流程包都问服务端要：装一个后端就该自动可选，用户自己写的流程包也一样\n  const backendsQuery = useQuery({\n    queryKey: ['experiment-backends'],\n    queryFn: () => api.listExperimentBackends(),\n    enabled: open,\n    retry: false,\n  });\n  const packsQuery = useQuery({\n    queryKey: ['process-packs'],\n    queryFn: () => api.listProcessPacks(),\n    enabled: open,\n    retry: false,\n  });\n  const ideas = ideasQuery.data ?? [];\n  const creds = credsQuery.data ?? [];\n  const backends = backendsQuery.data ?? [];\n  const packs = packsQuery.data ?? [];\n  const chosenBackend =\n    backends.find((b) => b.backend === backend) ?? backends.find((b) => b.is_default);\n  const needsSsh = backendNeedsSsh(backends, backend);\n\n  // 打开时重置表单 + 应用深链预选\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!open) return;\n    setIdeaId(initialIdeaId ?? '');\n    setMaxHours('');\n    setMaxRuns('10');\n    setBackend('');\n    setProcessPack('');\n    setQuestions([]);\n    setAnswers([]);\n    setIntakeState('idle');\n  }, [open, initialIdeaId]);\n\n  // 凭据加载后默认选第一个\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!open) return;\n    if (creds.length > 0 && !creds.some((c) => c.id === credentialId)) {\n      setCredentialId(creds[0]!.id);\n    }\n    if (creds.length === 0) setCredentialId('');\n  }, [open, creds, credentialId]);\n\n  // 选定 idea → AI 生成开题问题（失败/为空则静默降级：直接创建）\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!open || !ideaId) return;\n    let cancelled = false;\n    setIntakeState('loading');\n    setQuestions([]);\n    setAnswers([]);\n    api\n      .getExperimentIntakeQuestions(pid, ideaId)\n      .then((r) => {\n        if (cancelled) return;\n        const qs = (r.questions ?? []).slice(0, 5);\n        setQuestions(qs);\n        setAnswers(qs.map(() => ''));\n        setIntakeState(qs.length > 0 ?
